meta.title: Layout example: a figure and its explanation

blocks.text: These invented diagrams show a grouping process. The figure and its explanation form one reading object.

zh-CN.text: 这些自制示意图展示分组过程。图与解释共同构成一个阅读对象。

blocks.html:
Read the relationship. Each outline joins two items with the same label. The labels identify categories; the positions only make the pairs easy to compare.

A pair means shared membership. It does not imply that the items are equal in value.

zh-CN.html:
关注关系。每个轮廓把标签相同的两个项目连接起来。标签表示类别；位置只是为了便于比较各组。

同组表示归属相同，不表示项目的数值相等。

blocks.text: The [paired object](#observation) can also be stacked when its text needs the full reading width.

zh-CN.text: 当解释需要完整阅读宽度时，[这一组合](#observation)也可以上下排列。
